rules: All characters are independent playable protagonists
Private contradictions belong in the character's own personality, not global lore
Optional hooks are not canon unless the player approves them
Do not overwrite existing ECHO character configurations automatically
Resolve identities by character ID and obtain owner confirmation before applying

characters.name: Sebastian Valemont
characters.private_personality: Brave, charismatic duelist who hides a fear of failing loved ones. Protects others readily but struggles to accept help. His prestigious family treats excellence as an obligation.
characters.independent_story_hook: A consequential duel may force him to choose between reputation and integrity.

characters.name: Lucien Moreau
characters.private_personality: Analytical and perceptive, but uses understanding to avoid emotional vulnerability. Uncertainty unsettles him. Has partial archival clues to Aster; does not know Nela Ashbourne's true first name.
characters.independent_story_hook: An investigation into inconsistencies in old memories challenges his faith in perception.

characters.name: Theodore Hawthorne
characters.private_personality: Steady, caring alchemist who urges others to rest while pushing his own research too far. Fascinated by restoration and anomalous formulas; knows only fragments of a possible lost tradition.
characters.independent_story_hook: A past alchemical mistake and risky restoration research are optional hooks, not established facts.

characters.name: Ezra
characters.private_personality: Mischievous, loyal, emotionally perceptive through resonance, but hides fear of abandonment behind humor. His family undervalues resonant magic.
characters.independent_story_hook: Prove resonance deserves respect while learning to ask for care.

characters.name: Vivienne Blackwell
characters.private_personality: Independent and rebellious, yet can become controlling when afraid of losing someone. Resents a future chosen for her by her family.
characters.independent_story_hook: Choose her own future without dictating other people's choices.

characters.name: Alanis Fairchild
characters.private_personality: Gentle and reserved by choice, not weakness. Frustrated at being underestimated; defends others more readily than herself. Strong bond magic may react to betrayal.
characters.independent_story_hook: Learn to assert boundaries and express anger responsibly.

characters.name: Ophelia Ashbourne
characters.private_personality: Publicly Nela Ashbourne; birth first name Ophelia is secret, surname is public. Artistic manifestation and fragmented possible-future visions leave her exhausted and uncertain when to intervene.
characters.independent_story_hook: Investigate her name, visions and Aster without assuming any vision is inevitable.
